description: Objective: make PR #3548 (`ci/windows-pr-leg`) shippable without cross-PR blast radius, Windows CLI length limits, or collection errors. Review findings on #3548 (`535ebdfd0`): (1) High: `windows-targets` passes explicit file paths to `pytest`, which causes pytest to ignore `collect_ignore` in `tests/unit/scripts/oracle_reviewers/conftest.py:30` and fail collecting `test_local_review.py` on Windows (`ModuleNotFoundError: fcntl` in job 121669748570). (2) Medium: `windows_test_files` in `scripts/coverage_test_selection.py` unions `payload['develop_changed_tests']` (70/78, 17/18, and 23/24 of the targets in sampled runs), so one Windows-broken test on `develop` fails required `core` on every unrelated Python PR until the coverage map advances. (3) Low/latent: passing file paths on the Windows command line hits the 32,767-char `CreateProcess` cap around ~600 files; passing `@file` avoids the cliff. (4) L3 boundary: POSIX-only repo-tooling test paths (`tests/unit/scripts/oracle_reviewers/**`, `_project/sql-translation-ml/**`) should be excluded from `windows_test_files` so Linux-only developer tooling does not run on Windows. Prior art: modifies PR #3548 (`scripts/coverage_test_selection.py`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `tests/unit/workflows/test_ci_windows_pr_leg.py`) and merges cleanly with PR #3551 (`7b4969792`).
